overall_reason: A shadcn and Tailwind v4 theme layer exists, but the page's own chrome is written over it in literals: 207 distinct literal colours, fractional radii, four cyans for one accent and type down to 7px.

score.reason: T-HARDCODE fails on 179 literal colour declarations and 96 literals that retype tokens (TOK-006); T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-SCALE-FIT fail on the accent, radii and label sizes (TOK-001, TOK-004, TOK-003).

findings.where: stylesheet; top bar, studio info, game strip
findings.evidence: declarations.by_family.colour has 179 literal declarations against 561 var (var share 0.56), distinct_literal_colours is 207, and arbitrary_value_selectors lists 133 bracketed classes (.divide-[#333], .rounded-[1.6rem], .rounded-[1.65rem], .z-[10050] ...). literal_retypes_a_token_value: spacing 51, font size 21, colour 14, radius 10.
findings.before: Chrome values typed per rule beside a 115-token theme layer
findings.after: Components read the theme tokens; bracketed values go except where a value is truly one-off
findings.why: Typed values that repeat token values drift as soon as a token changes.
findings.root: per-component literals over the theme layer

findings.where: top bar buttons, studio info, card borders; 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: The accent cyan appears as #00d3f2 (Tailwind cyan-400; the Forums button and studio info text), #3de2f0 at /0.33 and /0.34 on borders, #00ffff/0.18 and #53eafd. Muted text on dark runs white at /0.80, /0.70, /0.50, /0.45, /0.40 and /0.20 (values.1440.colour_text).
findings.before: Four cyans and six white alphas
findings.after: One --accent cyan with one or two alpha steps; two muted-text roles
findings.why: The accent drifts between the framework's cyan and hand-typed cyans.

findings.where: 'NEW GAME' badges, key hints, engagement meta; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14px; 9px is span.text-[9px] (the NEW GAME and COMING SOON badges) and 10px is span.text-[10px] (key hints). At 375 a 7px size appears (text-[7px]). Font-size declarations are 60% literal; the type_ladder sweep counts 10 sizes.
findings.after: Two label steps (12px and 14px) from the theme scale
findings.why: Sizes a pixel apart do not form a hierarchy and push labels below a readable size.

findings.where: top bar buttons, search input, studio info panel; 1440
findings.evidence: values.1440.radius: 10.5px on the top bar buttons, 8.5px on the search input, 14.5px on the studio info panel, plus 4, 8 and 10px; the stylesheet adds .rounded-[1.6rem] and .rounded-[1.65rem].
findings.before: Fractional radii from calc() offsets and near-equal bracketed radii
findings.why: Fractional, near-equal radii read as rounding errors, not decisions.

findings.where: stylesheet layers; game strip and overlays
findings.evidence: values.1440.z_index runs 1, 2, 10, 20, 30, 50 and 9999; arbitrary selectors add .z-[120], .z-[200], .z-[9998] and .z-[10050].
findings.before: Layers typed per component up to 10050
findings.after: A named layer ladder in the theme
findings.why: Escalating layers fight when another overlay is added.

strengths: Spacing sits on 4px (99% on the grid) and the dark block redefines 27 of 28 semantic colours.
not_investigated: 85 requests were blocked, including the Exo 2 font files; the fallback_face sweep reports Consolas drawing two declared mono faces. Capture context, not judged.
